definition.title: Requirement-linked SysML v2 assume/guarantee obligation
definition.definition: One unit is one reviewed, independently checkable English requirement linked to its responsible SysML v2 owner, explicit assumptions, and complete guarantees or structural constraints. Each unit is typed as behavioral-contract or structural-conformance. Assumptions are tracked premises, not automatically verified successes.
definition.counting_rule: Freeze the reviewed requirement inventory and mappings before inspecting validation outcomes. Count each atomic requirement once; multiple clauses, guarantees, source lines, solver subgoals or shared proofs do not increase its count. Split a compound requirement only through a reviewed semantic decomposition. Report structural-conformance and behavioral-contract results separately; do not label a structural pass as a behavioral proof. All required obligations and subgoals for a unit must pass. Revise the denominator only through a new reviewed inventory, preserving prior results.
definition.rationale: Requirement-centered units preserve the connection from English intent to SysML ownership and GUMBO assumptions/guarantees, while avoiding inflated counts from lines, conjuncts or solver subgoals. Separate structural and behavioral categories make their different evidence strengths explicit.
definition.example_unit: Behavioral unit: retain the prior heat command when the current temperature is within the inclusive ordered desired-temperature band, under the declared mode and initialized state. Guarantee: the output equals the prior command and required state updates hold. Structural unit: the sensor output is connected to the regulator input with the required direction, type and ownership; this is checked against resolved architecture, not counted as a behavioral proof.
inclusion: Reviewed atomic English requirements with stable IDs and source anchors.
Behavioral requirements mapped to complete GUMBO initialization, compute or invariant contracts.
Structural requirements mapped to explicit SysML v2 parts, ports, connections, ownership, types, allocations or required properties.
exclusion: Standalone lines, syntax nodes, imports or declarations without an independently stated requirement.
Assumptions counted as satisfied merely because they were assumed.
Duplicate counts for a requirement implemented by multiple guarantees, cases, files or proof subgoals.
Unexecuted checks, model confidence and human approval as substitutes for verification evidence.
verification_evidence: Exact requirement-to-owner-to-contract/constraint mappings bound to source and configuration identities.
For behavioral-contract units: executed formal evidence for every required guarantee/subgoal under explicit assumptions, with initialization, state, arithmetic and timing semantics justified.
Assumption provenance and discharge: upstream component guarantees or explicitly reviewed environmental assumptions, with unresolved premises reported.
For structural-conformance units: executed resolved-architecture checks for all declared constraints; report as structural conformance rather than behavioral verification.
Non-vacuity and freshness checks, tool identities, proof scope and unresolved obligations.
acceptance_evidence: Requirement fidelity review and complete traceability.
All task-required formal, architecture, generation/build and independent-test gates, with failures or missing checks blocking acceptance.
Explicit disposition of environmental assumptions, unsupported behavior and limitations.
required_mapping_fields: unit_id, unit_kind, atomic_requirement_id, requirement_source_revision and exact passage.
SysML owner and formal element IDs, source file/region identities, assumptions, guarantees or structural constraints, phase and state semantics.
Assumption sources, upstream guarantee references, environment review references and unresolved premise IDs.
Executed gate IDs, proof/check artifacts, all subgoal mappings, tool/configuration identities, freshness and scope.
Separate structural_status, behavioral_verified_status and acceptance_status with exact evidence references.
limitations: This revision is an assistant suggestion responding to the user correction; it is not represented as a new Astra-generated response.
No unit inventory or verified count is established by approving this definition.

The current formal unit registry supports mapped GUMBO guarantees. Structural-unit inventories and their separate conformance aggregation must be implemented before reporting this mixed definition as an operational metric.
Reviewed requirements, assumption discharge and implementation/proof evidence remain necessary.
